_about: Context & Memory: memory on/off and the list first; the working space of a run on its own tab; standing instructions apart from memories; one answer each for how long memories last and who may read them. Per-run and per-Goal token caps move to Permissions Run limits.

memory-home.title: Your memories
memory-home.help: Turn memory on, then browse, pin, edit or forget what it keeps.

memory-context-meter.title: Context in use
memory-context-meter.help: How full the assistant's working space is right now.

memory-limits.title: When space runs low
memory-limits.help: How old context is squeezed so long runs keep going.

memory-notebook.title: Working notebook
memory-notebook.help: Notes the assistant keeps for itself during long tasks.

memory-limits-more.title: Fine-tune context space
memory-limits-more.help: How the space is split and what is trimmed first.

memory-assembly.title: Standing instructions
memory-assembly.help: Rules every run reads, in every project and in this one.

memory-assembly-view.title: What you can see
memory-assembly-view.help: Show what the assistant was given for each run.

memory-assembly-safety.title: Prompt safety checks
memory-assembly-safety.help: Keep these on unless you are tracking down a problem.

memory-retrieval.title: When memories are used
memory-retrieval.help: When memories are pulled in and how much fits in a reply.

memory-matching.title: How memories are matched
memory-matching.help: By meaning, by recency, or by exact words.

memory-fade.title: How long memories last
memory-fade.help: Days before an unused note of each kind fades.

memory-retention.title: Unconfirmed notes
memory-retention.help: Notes the assistant proposed that nobody has checked yet.

memory-sharing.title: Who else can read memories
memory-sharing.help: Helpers and crews see nothing unless you allow it.

memory-retention-tools.title: Tidy up
memory-retention-tools.help: Rebuild the search index, merge duplicates, prune old notes.

memory-sources.title: What can feed context
memory-sources.help: Turn off anything the assistant should not read on its own.

memory-rulepacks.title: Rule packs
memory-rulepacks.help: Every set of standing rules, where it comes from, and whether it loaded.
